data_issues: The unit (row) order of the test spikes is scrambled relative to train/val: test per-unit mean firing rates do not match the train/val units (e.g. test units 1,2,6,16,26 are nearly silent where the corresponding train units fire >1 spike/bin). Train and val are mutually consistent and stim_class matches movie_time_s exactly. I recovered the unit permutation by Hungarian matching of firing statistics refined with an EM/Poisson-likelihood assignment against class templates (validated: recovers scrambled val units and full accuracy), then decoded with a Poisson template decoder with per-trial gain (val acc 1.0). Test trials also have ~12% lower overall firing than train/val, so the decoder was made gain-invariant. Recovered mapping (train unit i -> test row): [3, 7, 9, 13, 18, 21, 12, 25, 4, 2, 15, 11, 5, 26, 14, 1, 19, 17, 24, 20, 27, 6, 22, 23, 10, 16, 8, 0, 28]
